segments.mil7.7.2:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘thanassitadārakassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamaṃ taṃ ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban”ti?
segments.mil7.7.2:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, thanassitadārako sadatthe laggati, khīratthiko rodati, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena sadatthe laggitabbaṃ, sabbattha dhammañāṇena bhavitabbaṃ, uddese paripucchāya sammappayoge paviveke garusaṃvāse kalyāṇamittasevane.
segments.mil7.7.2:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, thanassitadārakassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.7.2:1.5: Bhāsitampetaṃ, mahārāja, bhagavatā devātidevena dīghanikāyavare parinibbānasuttante –
segments.mil7.7.2:2.1: “‘Iṅghaṃ tumhe, ānanda, sāratthe [sadatthe (sī. pī.)] ghaṭatha, sāratthe anuyuñjatha; Sāratthe appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharathā’”ti.
